results.name: Wildfires in the Biobio and Nuble Regions, Chile
results.reason: A major wildfire event occurred in Chile beginning on 16 January 2026, with multiple large fires igniting in the Nuble and Biobio regions amid extreme heat, strong winds, and drought conditions. The fires were subsequently contained. Authorities reported at least 19 deaths and mass evacuations during the emergency. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide wildfire extent emergency mapping.
